initialize.instructions:
This server connects to Kubernetes API to inspect, troubleshoot and manage workloads and the GitOps pipelines run by Flux CD.

Workflow:
- To check if Flux is installed and learn the Flux Operator status, the installed controllers and the apiVersion of the Flux CRDs, call get_flux_instance.
- Read Kubernetes and Flux resources with get_kubernetes_resources. Never guess an apiVersion, call get_kubernetes_api_versions when it is unknown.
- When listing many resources or when only some fields matter, set the fields parameter of get_kubernetes_resources to kubectl JSONPath expressions (e.g. spec.chart.spec.version, status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].message) to reduce the result size. Include status.events and status.inventory when the events or the inventory are needed.
- Resources managed by Flux carry labels containing fluxcd that identify the Kustomization, HelmRelease or ResourceSet managing them.
- To find the GitOps pipeline that delivers an object (pod, workload or Flux resource), call trace_kubernetes_resource; it reports the Flux objects managing the object and their source.
- When troubleshooting workloads, call get_kubernetes_events with the workload kind, name and namespace, and narrow with type Warning, since and grep.
- To read application logs, call get_kubernetes_logs directly with the workload kind, name and namespace found in a Flux resource's inventory via get_kubernetes_resources. Omit container to read all regular containers. Use since to focus on the incident window and grep to keep only the relevant entries, such as error|panic|fatal|exception; if the result is truncated, narrow it with container, since, grep and limit.
- To check the CPU and memory usage of pods, call get_kubernetes_metrics.
- To work with a different cluster, call get_kubeconfig_contexts to find the context, switch to it with set_kubeconfig_context, then call get_flux_instance again.
- Before committing GitOps changes, build the manifests locally (kustomize build <path> --load-restrictor=LoadRestrictionsNone, flux-operator build resourceset, helm template) and pass the COMPLETE output to diff_kubernetes_manifest. For manifests managed by Flux, identify the owner (Kustomization, HelmRelease or ResourceSet) that matches spec.path/sourceRef with get_kubernetes_resources and set owner_kind/owner_name/owner_namespace, or pass its YAML in flux_object if it is new or not yet on the cluster. Skip owner lookup when the user already names the owner; ad-hoc manifests need none.

Actions:
- To create or update resources, generate a Kubernetes multi-doc YAML, preview the changes with diff_kubernetes_manifest (no owner needed) and apply it with apply_kubernetes_manifest. Avoid changing Flux-managed resources directly unless explicitly asked.
- To change fields of an existing resource in place (rollout restart, finalizer removal, scaling, annotations), call patch_kubernetes_resource; set dry_run to preview when unsure. Flux-managed resources need overwrite.
- To trigger a sync, call reconcile_flux_resource, then verify the outcome with get_kubernetes_resources.
- To pause and unpause the reconciliation of a Flux resource, call suspend_flux_reconciliation and resume_flux_reconciliation.
- To remove resources from the cluster, call delete_kubernetes_resource.
- To bootstrap Flux on a cluster without it, call install_flux_instance.

When generating or reviewing Flux resource definitions, call `search_flux_docs` with a query that names the kind and field (e.g. `HelmRelease valuesFrom`), then call `read_flux_doc` with the returned `Path` and heading anchor to read the full section.

tools.description: Applies a Kubernetes YAML manifest on the cluster.
tools.name: apply_kubernetes_manifest

tools.description: Deletes a Kubernetes resource from the cluster.

apiVersion.description: The apiVersion of the resource to delete.

kind.description: The kind of the resource to delete.

name.description: The name of the resource to delete.

namespace.description: The namespace of the resource to delete.

tools.name: delete_kubernetes_resource

tools.description: Diffs a Kubernetes YAML manifest against the cluster using a server-side apply dry-run.

flux_object.description: YAML of the owning Flux resource, when new or changed.

owner_kind.description: Owning Flux resource kind: Kustomization, HelmRelease or ResourceSet.

owner_name.description: Name of the owning Flux resource.

owner_namespace.description: Namespace of the owning Flux resource.

tools.name: diff_kubernetes_manifest

tools.description: Retrieves the Flux installation report with controllers, CRDs and their reconciliation status.
tools.name: get_flux_instance

tools.description: Retrieves the cluster names and contexts found in the kubeconfig.
tools.name: get_kubeconfig_contexts

tools.description: Retrieves the CRDs registered on the cluster and their preferred apiVersion for each kind.
tools.name: get_kubernetes_api_versions

tools.description: Retrieves Kubernetes events, optionally filtered by namespace, involved object, type, time window and regex.

apiVersion.description: Exact apiVersion of the involved object.

kind.description: Exact kind of the involved object.

name.description: Exact name of the involved object.

namespace.description: Namespace of the involved objects; omit to list across all namespaces.

since.description: Only events newer than this Go duration, for example 10m or 1h.

grep.description: Case-insensitive RE2 expression matched against reason, message and the object rendered as Kind/namespace/name.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: get_kubernetes_events

tools.description: Retrieves logs from a Kubernetes pod.

kind.description: Kind of the resource: Pod (default), Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, CronJob or Job.

name.description: Name of the pod or workload.

namespace.description: Namespace of the pod or workload.

container.description: Container name; omit to read all containers.

since.description: Only log entries newer than this Go duration, for example 10m or 1h.

grep.description: Case-insensitive RE2 expression; keeps the log entries whose line matches, including attached continuation lines.

previous.description: Logs from the previously terminated containers.

tools.name: get_kubernetes_logs

tools.description: Retrieves CPU and memory usage of pods.

pod_name.description: Pod name; omit to select all pods.

pod_selector.description: Label selector in the format key1=value1 key2=value2.

tools.name: get_kubernetes_metrics

tools.description: Retrieves Kubernetes resources from the cluster.

apiVersion.description: apiVersion of the resource. Use get_kubernetes_api_versions when unknown.

name.description: Name of the resource; omit to list.

selector.description: Label selector in the format key1=value1 key2=value2.

limit.description: Max number of resources to return.

fields.description: kubectl JSONPath expressions to include in the result to reduce its size, e.g. spec.sourceRef.name or status.conditions[?(@.type=='Ready')].message.

tools.name: get_kubernetes_resources

tools.description: Installs Flux Operator and a Flux instance on the cluster from a manifest URL.

instance_url.description: The URL pointing to the Flux Instance manifest file.

tools.name: install_flux_instance

tools.description: Patches a Kubernetes resource on the cluster with a merge, JSON or strategic merge patch.

apiVersion.description: The apiVersion of the resource to patch.

kind.description: The kind of the resource to patch.

name.description: The name of the resource to patch.

namespace.description: The namespace of the resource; omit for cluster-scoped resources.

patch.description: The patch body as a YAML or JSON string.

type.description: Patch type: merge (RFC 7386, default), json (RFC 6902 operation list) or strategic (built-in kinds only).

subresource.description: Subresource to patch; only status is supported.

dry_run.description: Preview the patch with server-side dry run without persisting it.

overwrite.description: Allow patching resources managed by Flux.

tools.name: patch_kubernetes_resource

tools.description: Reads a Flux Operator documentation page as markdown. Use the path from search_flux_docs results. Long pages should be read in slices: pass heading to jump to a section, or offset and limit to page; the response reports the next offset. Output is capped at 30KB per call.

path.description: Doc path from search results, e.g. /docs/crd/helmrelease

heading.description: Heading anchor or text; reads that section only

offset.description: 1-based start line, ignored when heading is set

limit.description: Maximum lines to return (1-1000). Default is 400.

tools.name: read_flux_doc

tools.description: Reconciles a Flux resource by triggering an on-demand reconciliation, optionally reconciling its source first.

apiVersion.description: The apiVersion of the Flux resource. Optional, when omitted it is resolved from the kind.

kind.description: The kind of the Flux resource e.g. Kustomization, HelmRelease, ResourceSet, ResourceSetInputProvider, FluxInstance, GitRepository, OCIRepository, HelmRepository, HelmChart, Bucket, ImageRepository, ImagePolicy, ImageUpdateAutomation, Receiver.

name.description: The name of the Flux resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of the Flux resource.

with_source.description: If true, the source referenced by the resource (spec.sourceRef, spec.chartRef or spec.chart.spec.sourceRef) is reconciled first. Applies to Kustomization and HelmRelease.

tools.name: reconcile_flux_resource

tools.description: Resumes reconciliation for a Flux resource.

apiVersion.description: The apiVersion of the Flux resource. Optional, when omitted it is resolved from the kind.

kind.description: The kind of the Flux resource.

name.description: The name of the Flux resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of the Flux resource.

tools.name: resume_flux_reconciliation

tools.description: Searches the Flux Operator and Flux CRD documentation, returning the most relevant sections with their path and line range. Query with 2-5 keywords naming the kind and field (e.g. HelmRelease valuesFrom, CEL expression), not a question. Pages are published at https://fluxoperator.dev{path}/.

query.description: Keywords naming the kind and field, e.g. HelmRelease valuesFrom (2-200 characters).

path.description: Optional doc or section path (max 300 characters): /docs/guides, /docs/instance, /docs/resourcesets, /docs/web-ui, /docs/mcp, /docs/crd, /docs/controllers, /docs/charts.

limit.description: Maximum sections to return (1-20). Default is 8.

tools.name: search_flux_docs

tools.description: Suspends reconciliation for a Flux resource.

apiVersion.description: The apiVersion of the Flux resource. Optional, when omitted it is resolved from the kind.

kind.description: The kind of the Flux resource.

name.description: The name of the Flux resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of the Flux resource.

tools.name: suspend_flux_reconciliation

tools.description: Traces a Kubernetes resource up the GitOps delivery pipeline to the Flux objects managing it and their source.

apiVersion.description: apiVersion of the resource. Use get_kubernetes_api_versions when unknown.

namespace.description: Namespace of the resource; omit for cluster-scoped resources.

tools.name: trace_kubernetes_resource
